Forgetting, drawn by day

A list of thirty words was read once, then tested on the days after. The share still recalled falls fast at first and then levels off, which is the shape every forgetting study finds when nothing is reviewed in between.

alt.Chart(recall).mark_line().encode(x="Day:Q", y="Recalled:Q").properties(title="Words recalled by day")

Reviewing a word just before it would be lost resets the curve, and each review makes the next fall slower. That is the whole idea behind spacing reviews out.

A chart that would not draw stood above this line, and the last words of the page come after it.
